evidenceRole: Post-hoc mechanism and invariant validation after the D5 untouched test was consumed. This protocol cannot provide a new confirmatory efficacy claim.

arms.challenger: Exact D5 target-state context produced by budget-1-state-3.
arms.guarded: Return the challenger only with a label-free structural dominance certificate; otherwise return exact V1.

acceptanceRules: Every graph-known current V1 unit is retained.
Every graph-unknown V1 unit is retained.
No graph-known stale unit is newly introduced.
Challenger tokens do not exceed the actual V1 tokens.

invariant.scope: When the operation graph is complete and matches the evaluation state, the selected context cannot lose graph-known current-state recall, cannot worsen graph-known stale absence, retains every graph-unknown V1 item by identity, and cannot spend more tokens than V1.
nonClaims: The operation graph is not extracted by this experiment.
Identity preservation does not prove answer-level semantic non-inferiority.
A post-hoc MemOps gain is not confirmation on new data.

aggregation.primary: All 320 CandidateDisambiguation cases, reported together and by their original D5 phase.

outcomeSemantics.pass: The guard is a viable safety contraction for future fresh-data testing; V1 remains the incumbent.
outcomeSemantics.promotion: Forbidden from this post-hoc protocol regardless of point estimates.
